tdeck.notes: Typing feels instant: eliminated input stalls during busy mesh traffic, fixed phantom double letters, and deferred background work off the keyboard. New: select words with the joypad or trackball (left to select, backspace to delete), tap to place the cursor and edit mid-message (T-Deck). Plus a globe icon for the MeshOS channel, international characters now sit correctly in Modern font, and a clearer message when updating without an SD card.
